limitations: All source roots are disposable pytest fixtures on the existing host, not an immutable APFS snapshot.

The path walker opens every absolute path component with O_NOFOLLOW, and readers hold root and child descriptors, but this is not OS snapshot identity or protection from concurrent mutation of the overall fixture.

The SQLite source-family binding checks lstat/fstat metadata only. Fixture setup separately creates the online backup from its disposable synthetic database, so the whole rehearsal does read that synthetic DB logically.
Snapshot identity, durable cutoff, policy/tool attestations, and event timestamps remain declared synthetic fields.
The protected root is only verified as an opaque captured artifact; it is not source-bound. One excluded descendant remains unresolved, so full owner root closure is not claimed.
Metadata parity does not qualify restore xattrs/ACLs/flags or host ownership mapping. No clean-host restore or erase readiness is established.

review.remaining_source_binding_decision: review the held-descriptor and SQLite metadata-only changes; implement a real snapshot-bound adapter only after source snapshot and host capacity gates pass
